sentences.text:
R/Special Criminal Application No. 3227 of 2025
 (For Consent Quashing)
 =======================================================
 Dhaval Raju Shah
 Versus
 State Of Gujarat & Anr.
 =================================================

= =
 Appearance:
 Aditya C Yagnik(8228) for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Jayani B Shah(8495) for the Applicant(s) No. 1
 Mr Chintan Dave App for the Respondent(s) No. 1
 Ms Rajnit Vyas for the Respondent No.2

= = = 
 Coram:Honourable Mr. Justice Divyesh A. Joshi
 Date : 07/04/2025
 Oral Order
1. With the consent of learned advocates appearing for the parties, present application is taken up for final disposal today.
2. Rule.
Learned advocates appearing for the parties waive service of notice of Rule.

3. By way of the present application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, the 'Code'), the applicant prays for quashing and setting aside the FIR being C.R.
No.11196001230024/2023 registered with Mahila Police Station, Vadodara for the offence punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506(2) and 114 of the Indian Penal Code and under Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and chargesheet filed thereunder.
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/3227/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined

sentences.text: Heard learned advocate, Ms. Jayati Shah for the applicant, learned APP Mr. Chintan Davefor respondent no.1 and learned advocate, Ms. Rajnit Vyas for respondent no.2, who is permitted to file his Vakalatnama in the Registry.
I have also heard the respondent no.2 - complainant, who is present before this Court.
Learned advocate, M. Vyas identifies respondent no.2 and confirms correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by him.

5. When the matter is called out, learned advocates appearing for the parties have submitted that now the dispute is amicably settled between the parties and, therefore, the respondent no.2 has filed an affidavit before this Court, copy of which is placed on record at Page No.30.

They have also stated that in fact, both the parties have approached the learned Family Court for obtaining decree of divorce, wherein the learned Judge concerned passed an order of decree of divorce and thus, both have now separated by the order of the learned Judge concerned.

Upon making inquiry, the respondent no.2, who is present before this Court, has stated that she has settled the dispute with the present applicant and, therefore, if the impugned FIR is quashed, she has no objection.

6. Therefore since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through her learned advocate,
NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/3227/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/04/2025 undefined the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.
7. Resultantly, this application is allowed.

The impugned FIR being C.R. No.11196001230024/2023 registered with Mahila Police Station, Vadodara and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said FIR are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicant.
8. Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.

(DIVYESH A. JOSHI, J.) Gautam Dhaval Raju Shah vs State Of Gujarat on 7 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52283197/
